model.name: DeepSeek-V4 Flash CSA Distributed Operator Implementation

notes: This is a stage-2 distributed operator implementation graph derived from PyPTO decode_csa.py, not a stage-1 DeepSeek source-model architecture graph.
The canonical graph covers one ratio-4 CSA operator plus a collapsed decoder-layer FFN context.
The captured _jit_l3_decode_csa artifact is a standalone two-rank operator trace, not a complete-model trace.
CSA resolves for layers 2,4,...,42; layer 3 resolves to HCA and does not execute this branch.
